metrics.sharpe_basis: Daily simple equity returns including first day vs starting equity; sample stdev ddof=1; annualization sqrt(252); zero risk-free rate.

accounting.fifo_basis: Matched FIFO segments; both entry and exit costs; open remaining inventory excluded.
accounting.round_basis: Exact real contract, from flat to flat; partial closes within a still-open round excluded from complete rounds.

limitations: Repeated historical sample and combined three-item ablation; not independent marginal attribution, PIT, OOS, or promotion evidence.

Stage028 source disputes, accepted-observation week gaps and historical main mapping timestamp limitations remain.
